title: Favorites and files shared with you
intro: Star the files you use most. Find what other people have shared with you.

sections.heading: See what other people have shared with you
steps: Click **Shared with me** in the left rail.
Click any row to open it where it lives. The **Permission** column shows what you can do there.

sections.heading: Star a file
steps: Point to a file and click the star on its row. The star turns solid.
bullets: Click **Favorites** in the left rail to see your starred files in this library.
